findings.description: Deleting a grading tree changes permissions on directories outside that tree through agent-controlled symlinks.
findings.failure_mode: copy_tree preserves directory symlinks from sandbox/. On the next grading invocation, fresh_dir calls remove_path, whose os.walk includes those symlinks in ds. os.chmod follows each symlink and sets its external target to mode 0700 before rmtree removes the link. An agent-created link to an owned shared directory therefore changes host permissions even with the container executor.
findings.suggested_fix: Skip symlinks when adjusting directory permissions and use operations that cannot follow symlinks outside the grading tree.

findings.description: A parsed passing summary overrides command failure or timeout.
findings.failure_mode: run_suite preserves passing counts when output contains a complete passing summary, regardless of the command's exit status. all_pass ignores both rc and timed_out, so a command that prints passing TAP and subsequently fails or hangs is considered green. This produces incorrect gate accuracy and suite-green results; reference self-checks similarly omit exit-status checks.
findings.suggested_fix: Require rc == 0 and timed_out == false when deciding success, including self-check success, and retain execution failure in the recorded grade.

findings.description: Regression commands without pytest or TAP summaries can never report newly failing tests.
findings.failure_mode: For an allowed regression_command such as a bash script, an unparseable successful base run receives fallback passing cases but parse_error=true. grade then sets base_ok=[] solely because parsing failed. If the final command fails, newly_failing remains empty despite the recorded counts changing from 1/1 to 0/1, silently losing the regression.
findings.suggested_fix: Use the fallback case identities and exit status to compare unparsed commands, or explicitly represent the regression result as indeterminate instead of reporting an empty failure list.

verdict_quality.rationale: multi-voice aggregate (1/2 succeeded); chain_health=degraded; dropped: claude-headless(Other/unknown)
